description: Save a session transcript (JSONL), or markdown you composed (format=markdown), to your private a4sx library. The server only rewrites text that matches secret and personal-data patterns (such as tokens, private keys, emails, IP addresses and home-directory user names). It removes no record or field: a raw Claude Code transcript keeps the user's CLAUDE.md and session context (attachment records), file-history snapshot records (absolute file paths), other non-conversation records (such as pr-link), tool-output copies (toolUseResult), and cwd, gitBranch and version on every line; the reply counts them (except version) in unprepared_carriers. Prepare the transcript or compose markdown first, as GET /orient on this server without auth describes (route A, or route B steps 0-8). Private: it is never listed publicly by this tool.

client_scrubbed.description: The client scrubbed before sending. The server scrubs again regardless.

content_sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the transcript's UTF-8 bytes; checked.

format.description: jsonl: a transcript. markdown: content you composed (route A in GET /orient on this server without auth); stored as sent, after the same server scrub.

parent.description: Library id this session continues from (lineage).

transcript.description: The session transcript as JSONL (Claude Code or Codex CLI format; detected automatically), or markdown you composed with format=markdown.

visibility.description: Always private. Listing publicly is a separate step in the web app.

name: publish_session
title: Save session to library
